subject: Quick note on Carson & Trotter's website
bodyText:
Hi,

I'm Mani from Rogue.

We look for solid businesses that still look stuck online - and Carson & Trotter stood out.

Dumfries chartered accountants on Irish Street - and carsontrotter.co.uk still ships as HTML 4.01 Strict in iso-8859-1, still publishes Fax: 01387 250017 in the live footer, and still loads the classic ga.js analytics snippet. Ninety-plus years serving South West Scotland; a front end that still reads like a mid-2000s professional brochure with a live fax line.

If useful, I'll send a short 3-point teardown over email - what's dated, what's costing you, and the first fix. No call required.

Reply YES and I'll send it.
